change_description: Added strict blind-cohort validation checks: vetoes color_excess_detected=True, vetoes SUPPORTED_PHOTOSPHERIC_CONSISTENCY, vetoes POSSIBLE_INFRARED_EXCESS, and enforces mandatory inclusion of BLIND_COHORT_UNVERIFIED_BASELINE.

Implemented active fail-closed promotion veto: when is_blind_cohort is True, forces color_excess_detected=False, maps POSSIBLE_INFRARED_EXCESS and SUPPORTED_PHOTOSPHERIC_CONSISTENCY to UNVERIFIABLE, preserves candidate indication in metadata, and documents reason.

Created comprehensive 20-test safety suite verifying all blind-cohort promotion restrictions, fallback behavior, contract vetoes, raw measurement preservation, FUSION-X score invariance, and Phase 3 compatibility.
